# pvp
Combat for Minestom

## What does this have over MinestomPvP?
- 26.2 support
- Maces
- Spears
- Accurate crystal PVP
- Wind charges
- Copper armor and tools
- Elytra firework boosts
- Water extinguishing
- Weaving, oozing, infested, wind-charged mob death effects
- Hundreds of fixes related to damage, knockback, explosions, projectiles, potions, enchantments, and more

## Server flags
- `-Dminestom.enforce-entity-interaction-range=false`: Minestom drops attack packets on targets further than
  the interaction range plus one block, while vanilla accepts up to three blocks past it. The attack feature
  applies the vanilla range check itself, so disable the Minestom check for vanilla hit registration.
